chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:

I asked him about a man who enters janabah in his garment: may he dry himself with it after his ghusl? He said: “Yes, there is no harm in it, unless the semen in it is still wet; but if it is dry, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.النُّطْفَةُ: the semen referred to in this legal context
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can a person dry himself with a garment containing dried semen after ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a garment affected by semen and whether it may be used to dry oneself after ghusl. It indicates that there is no problem if the semen has dried, while a wet trace is treated differently due to its continuing impurity.
